benchmark: Merged open-source no-lid box heave at the three recorded sample frequencies, head seas; identical dimensions, mesh, gravity, density, depth, centre of mass and gyradii
criterion_basis: Beforehand pilot screening inputs, not a standard-derived allowance or experimental uncertainty. Each benchmark response must satisfy absolute difference <= absolute tolerance + relative tolerance * abs(reference). Finest-pair head-sea heave change must satisfy the convergence absolute tolerance.
scope: Reproduction of an already-merged open-source calculation and limited panel sensitivity, not independent experimental validation
